_doc: Reconciliation map for app:build-court-coverage. Source: HG 1217/2023 (MO 1102/07.12.2023), annex of localities per judecatorie circumscription. Resolves naming differences between the annex, data/courts.json and data/cities.json, plus de-facto routing for suspended courts. Keep in lockstep with data/sources/hotarare-1217-2023.txt.

court_remap._doc: Annex court that is de-facto suspended -> operational court that currently handles its localities. Its annex localities are merged into the target. Empty: Judecatoria Baia de Arama was initially remapped to Strehaia but the lawyer confirmed (2026-07, portal.just.ro id 181, hearings scheduled) it is operational, so it is a normal court now (added to courts.json).

skip_courts._doc: Annex court entries to ignore entirely. Judecatoria Insuratei: suspended (lawyer-confirmed 2026-07, portal.just.ro id 247 announcement); its localities are already listed under Braila/Faurei with a transition note. Bucharest sectors: coverage kept as-is in courts.json ([Sector N]).

court_aliases._doc: Annex court name -> data/courts.json court name (hyphen/spelling differences).

uat_aliases._doc: County|AnnexLocalityName -> exact data/cities.json name (hyphen/punctuation/diacritic/rename differences). Bihor|Petreu: commune renamed Abramut. Some target names carry cities.json data-quality quirks (kept verbatim so import matches).

known_gaps._doc: UATs present in data/cities.json but absent from HG 1217/2023 (communes created in 2004, not carried into the circumscription annex). Left uncovered on purpose: the resolver falls back to manual court selection. Do NOT fabricate a competence the law does not assign. Assign only if a newer HG amends the annex.
